description: L2 diagnostic runtime triage dashboard: where pipeline runtime loses time, fails, accumulates backlog, or raises warning/error conditions. Prometheus-first answer row first; logs/traces stay in a collapsed drilldown row for the optional tracing profile. Retry-vs-failure and batch-size distribution remain blocked pending bounded runtime instrumentation, so the dashboard only uses shipped metric families and recording rules.

options.content:
2. Runtime / $pipeline / $run_type

Current window: 15m status, 30m terminal-run evidence. Selected range: diagnostics only.

panels.description: Runtime L2 scope. Current status panels use fixed recording-rule windows; selected-range panels below are evidence only. If current status is UNKNOWN, inspect telemetry gap before treating zero count cards as OK.
panels.title: Runtime Scope

panels.description: Diagnostic Scope Note

options.content: Diagnostic Scope Note: This dashboard uses L2 diagnostic flow with Prometheus-first mode. Core triage panels use Prometheus metrics shipped with BioETL. Tracing-only Log Hygiene panels (below, collapsed) require optional tracing profile and use Loki for log-level diagnostics. For deeper investigation, drill down to DQ / Control Plane / Provider Health dashboards.

panels.title: Diagnostic Scope Note

panels.description: Current snapshot from canonical recording rules. Status mapping: 0=OK, 1=DEGRADED/WARN, >=2=FAILING/CRIT, null=UNKNOWN/no runtime status data. If UNKNOWN, check Monitor Runtime Telemetry Gap and Prometheus scrape/rule health before trusting zero count panels. Labels: pipeline, run_type. Next action: inspect top blocker reason, then active blocker detail or logs/traces.
panels.title: Monitor Runtime Current Status

panels.description: Current scrape gap for BioETL runtime metrics over 10m. 0=OK/scraping, 1=WARN/no recent scrape, >=2=CRIT reserved, null=UNKNOWN/no scrape series. Time scope: current monitoring health, not selected-range runtime evidence. If this is 1 or UNKNOWN, treat zero count panels as inconclusive and open Prometheus Targets before debugging pipeline code.
panels.title: Monitor Runtime Telemetry Gap

panels.description: Range-evidence summary note for the KPI cards below. The cards support runtime localization after the current-status answer row; they do not replace the current blocker recording rules. UNKNOWN means missing status telemetry or scrape/rule gap until proven otherwise.

options.content: Incident Summary: first-pass KPIs for blocker count, failed runs, worst stage lag, and runtime error rate. Use these before expanding deeper diagnostics.

panels.title: Incident Summary

panels.description: Top active pipeline-level runtime blocker reasons with severity and action_target labels. Time scope: current recording-rule snapshot. This intentionally aggregates across run_type because canonical blocker reasons are emitted as pipeline-level current state. Empty table means no current blocker reason only when Runtime status and telemetry gap are not UNKNOWN.
panels.title: Inspect Top Runtime Blockers

panels.description: 15m current-window count of active canonical pipeline-level runtime blocker reasons. Uses recording rules for first-screen status and intentionally ignores stage/run_type to avoid filtering away output/gold blockers. 0 is normal only when Monitor Runtime Current Status and Monitor Runtime Telemetry Gap are not UNKNOWN. Next action: inspect top blocker detail.
panels.title: Runtime Blockers

panels.description: Failed pipeline executions over the last 15m for selected pipeline/run_type. 0 means no failed-run counter increase when runtime telemetry is available; UNKNOWN/No data or telemetry gap means the failure count is inconclusive. Next action: open logs/traces or the pipeline failure runbook.

dataLinks.title: Open Logs (Loki, contextual scope marker, tracing)

panels.title: Failed Runs

panels.description: Pipeline-level runtime error rate over last 30m. bioetl_errors_total is scoped by pipeline/stage/error_code, so this panel intentionally ignores run_type in the numerator and uses Bronze input as denominator. No data is UNKNOWN/missing error or input telemetry, not 0. Next action: open Errors by Stage/Error Code and check failed runs/backlog/lag.
panels.title: Runtime Error Rate

panels.description: Worst observed stage lag across stages over the last 15m for selected pipeline/run_type. This intentionally ignores the stage variable to surface the worst blocker. No data is UNKNOWN/missing lag telemetry; 0 is only valid when the metric is scraped and no lag is present. Next action: expand Stage Backlog Trend and logs.
panels.title: Worst Stage Lag

panels.description: Shows each active runtime blocker recording rule with its current value. Empty table means no active blockers.
panels.title: Active Runtime Blocker Detail
First Action
panels.description: First operator action for Runtime triage. Uses current snapshot panels before selected-range evidence. UNKNOWN means missing status telemetry or scrape/rule gap until proven otherwise.

options.content: First action: read Monitor Runtime Current Status, then inspect the top blocker reason. If status is FAILING, open the active blocker detail; if DEGRADED, inspect terminal-run/stage lag evidence; if UNKNOWN, verify Monitor Runtime Telemetry Gap before treating zero as OK.

panels.description: Sustained backlog accumulation by stage.
panels.title: Stage Backlog Trend

panels.description: Shows expected vs observed stage status per entity config. Gold status is contextual: expected (scd2/append/overwrite config), disabled (gold_enabled=false), pending (run active, gold not yet written), or missing (run completed, gold=0).
panels.title: Stage Expectedness

panels.description: Processed records by stage over the active Grafana interval.
panels.title: Records by Stage / Interval

panels.description: Phase latency distribution across p50, p95, and p99.
panels.title: Pipeline Phase Duration p50/p95/p99

panels.description: Pipeline duration percentiles by stage. "No terminal pipeline duration samples" means no completed pipeline runs emitted duration histogram buckets in the selected range. Possible causes: run still active, terminal metric not emitted, query label mismatch.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, stage, status, run_type) (rate(bioetl_pipeline_duration_seconds_bucket{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type",stage=~"$stage"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Pipeline Duration p50/p95/p99

panels.description: Error breakdown by stage and error code over the selected Grafana time range.
panels.title: Errors by Stage / Error Code / Range

panels.description: Processed-record totals over the active range, grouped by stage and run_type.
panels.title: Records by Stage / Run Type / Range

panels.description: Graceful-shutdown initiation events over the active Grafana interval.
panels.title: Shutdown Initiated by Reason / Interval

panels.description: Graceful-shutdown completion events over the active Grafana interval.
panels.title: Shutdown Completed by Reason / Interval

panels.description: Runtime-owned selected-window handoff summary from shipped 15m/30m recording rules for preflight, infrastructure, failed-run, and error-rate blockers. 0 means no condition rule is firing when telemetry is available; UNKNOWN or telemetry gap means inconclusive. Next action: use Active Runtime Blocker Detail or the pipeline failure runbook.

targets.expr: ((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_pipeline_preflight_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_pipeline_infrastructure_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_pipeline_runs_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_runtime_error_rate_high_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Pipeline Alert Conditions

panels.description: DQ handoff only. Uses shipped 15m/30m DQ recording rules to show whether runtime symptoms may be downstream of data-quality failures. Runtime does not diagnose record-level DQ here; open Data Quality for reasons, thresholds, and Silver rejects. 0 is normal only when telemetry is available.

targets.expr: ((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_dq_soft_threshold_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_dq_hard_fail_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_dq_critical_anomaly_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_silver_validation_failures_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)))

panels.title: DQ Alert Conditions

panels.description: Control Plane / Replay Safety handoff only. Uses shipped 15m/30m recording rules for manifest, checkpoint, replay, and lineage blockers. Runtime does not decide replay/resume safety here; open Control Plane for manifest, checkpoint, and ledger evidence. 0 is normal only when telemetry is available.

targets.expr: ((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_manifest_write_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_ledger_append_failed_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_checkpoint_incompatible_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_replay_lag_high_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_replay_drift_detected_30m{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_lineage_refs_missing_15m{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}) or vector(0)))

panels.title: Control-plane Alert Conditions

panels.description: GLOBAL Provider Health handoff only. Uses shipped 15m/30m/1h provider recording rules without pipeline filtering because provider failures can block multiple pipelines. Runtime does not diagnose provider root cause here; open Provider Health for provider/current-cause evidence. 0 is normal only when telemetry is available.

targets.expr: ((sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_failure_rate_high_15m) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_retries_exhausted_1h) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_adapter_latency_high_30m) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_http_error_rate_high_15m) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_rate_limiter_wait_high_30m) or vector(0)) + (sum(bioetl_runtime_alert_condition_provider_rate_limiter_tokens_depleted_15m) or vector(0)))

panels.title: GLOBAL Provider Alert Conditions

panels.description: Freshness handoff only. Counts selected-pipeline entities older than 24h using data freshness telemetry; this supports source/DQ escalation and is not a Runtime execution blocker by itself. 0 means no stale entity when telemetry is available; UNKNOWN means missing freshness telemetry.

targets.expr: sum(clamp_min(time() - max by (pipeline, entity) (bioetl_data_freshness_seconds{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}), 0) > 86400) or vector(0)

panels.title: Freshness Alert Conditions

panels.description: No-records runs detected over the last 30m for selected pipeline/run_type. This is a runtime blocker candidate when runs occurred but no records were processed. 0 is valid only when both run and records counters are scraped; telemetry gaps are inconclusive. Next action: inspect checkpoint/resume and stage expectedness.

targets.expr: sum(((sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_pipeline_runs_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}[30m])) > 0) unless on (pipeline, run_type) (sum by (pipeline, run_type) (increase(bioetl_records_processed_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline",run_type=~"$run_type"}[30m])) > 0))) or vector(0)

panels.title: No-Records Runs

panels.description: Adaptive memory pressure state over the last 15m. 0=OK/no active pressure, 1=WARN/runtime memory pressure active, >=2=CRIT reserved for future severity recording rules, null=UNKNOWN/missing memory telemetry. This is stage-level and intentionally ignores run_type because the metric labels are pipeline/stage/reason/monitor_mode/status. Next action: open logs and inspect checkpoint/resume pressure before retrying.
panels.title: Memory Pressure Active
Tracing-only Log Hygiene (requires optional tracing profile)

panels.description: Structured warning-level log events over the selected time range.
panels.title: Warnings

panels.description: Log events that failed JSON parsing or are missing expected fields over the selected Range.
panels.title: Unstructured Logs

panels.description: Top warning events by message over the selected time range.
panels.title: Top Warning Events

panels.title: Log Hygiene Trend
